svg.title: AED action card — main action flow
svg.desc: A working Australian automated external defibrillator action flow. Continue CPR until the AED is on and pads are attached, expose the chest, attach pads exactly as pictured, keep everyone clear during analysis and shock, then immediately resume CPR. A separate companion card covers pad contact, children, medication patches and implanted devices.
svg.text: AED: main action flow
WARNING — CLINICAL REVIEW OUTSTANDING
Editorial estimate: wording 95%; stressed-reader use 70%.
Use only when unresponsive and not breathing normally.
Follow 000 and every AED prompt. Do not delay compressions to read.
KEEP CPR GOING
Continue CPR until the AED is on and pads are attached.
A helper prepares it while CPR continues.
If alone, follow prompts; minimise the pad pause.
TURN IT ON AND EXPOSE THE CHEST
Use the pad-safety card for contact hazards.
Keep following the spoken prompts.
ATTACH THE PADS
Press pads firmly on bare skin, as their pictures show.
Actual pad pictures and prompts—not this drawing—control.
EVERYONE CLEAR
No one touches the person during AED analysis or shock.
If told to shock, check everyone is clear.
Press if instructed. Restart CPR when the AED tells you.
RESUME CPR IMMEDIATELY
After a shock—or no-shock advice—restart when told.
Keep following prompts; use the CPR stopping rules.
See “AED pads and safety” before placing pads when possible.
WORKING DRAFT — main card; clinical and stressed-reader review outstanding
